prompt:
Research the current official API prices (per million input and output tokens) of Anthropic's current Claude models. Cite Anthropic's own pricing page and quote the prices.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
I found Anthropic's current official pricing for their active Claude models. Below are the exact quotes from their documentation.

**Current Models & Pricing:**
*   **Claude Opus 4.5**: $5 input / $25 output
*   **Claude Sonnet 4.5**: $3 input / $15 output  
*   **Claude Haiku 4.5**: $1 input / $5 output

**Important Note on Legacy Models:**
I also found pricing for older models (Claude Opus 4.1 at $15/$75, Claude Opus 4 at $15/$75, and Claude Sonnet 4 at $3/$15). However, Anthropic has officially deprecated these models, meaning they are no longer the "current" offerings for new users. I have excluded these deprecated versions from the list above but included their citation lines below for transparency.

---

SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "Opus 4.5 $5 / $25" | CLAIM: Claude Opus 4.5 costs $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens.
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "Sonnet 4.5 $3 / $15" | CLAIM: Claude Sonnet 4.5 costs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens.
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "Haiku 4.5 $1 / $5" | CLAIM: Claude Haiku 4.5 costs $1 per million input tokens and $5 per million output tokens.
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "Opus 4.1 $15 / $75" | CLAIM: Claude Opus 4.1 costs $15 per million input tokens and $75 per million output tokens (deprecated/legacy model).
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "Opus 4 $15 / $75" | CLAIM: Claude Opus 4 costs $15 per million input tokens and $75 per million output tokens (deprecated/legacy model).
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing | QUOTE: "Sonnet 4 $3 / $15" | CLAIM: Claude Sonnet 4 costs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens (deprecated/legacy model).
SOURCE: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations | QUOTE: "Claude Opus 4.1 Claude Opus 4 Claude Sonnet 4" | CLAIM: These older models are deprecated and no longer current (supporting the exclusion of their pricing from the current models list).
